explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/416: 'Is there an asymptotic formula for V(x)?'. The Lean statement is V(x)/answer(x) → 1 for a function answer : ℝ → ℝ to be supplied, the upstream pattern for value questions. This is the natural encoding of 'an asymptotic formula', but as a formal statement it is satisfied by answer := V, so its content rests entirely on the informal requirement that the answer be an explicit/closed-form expression (which upstream declares out of scope). The docstring does not flag this. Acceptable formalisation of an inherently informal question; the 'research open' status also deserves a recheck given the cited preprint [OAI26a] is titled as an asymptotic formula for the number of totients.
